Buy the Rare Quincy Action Figure early for a big payout later.
He can't pop Lead himself; from level 8 the Gerry's Fire item gives a tower fire damage.

pairs.note: Fertilizer boosts farms.

levels.text: Shop opens: Shooty Turret, Stack of Old Nails, Creepy Idol, Jar of Pickles. Short-range magic attack.
New item: Rare Quincy Action Figure, which sells for more the longer you keep it.
New item: See Invisibility Potion (temporary Camo). More range.
New item: Tube of Amaz-o-Glue, slows Bloons on the track.
New item: Sharpening Stone (+pierce for sharp attacks). Faster attacks.
New item: Worn Hero's Cape turns a Dart Monkey (tier 2 or lower) into a Super Monkey, capped at tier 3.
New item: Blade Trap, a spinning-blade burst when a visible Bloon touches it. Stronger attack.
New item: Gerry's Fire hot sauce gives a Monkey, hero or minion a fire attack for 5 rounds.
New item: Fertilizer boosts a Banana Farm for a few rounds. Bigger blast.
New item: Pet Rabbit.

Shooty Turret fires faster and harder; nails hit harder.
See Invisibility Potion gives more range and lasts longer.
Sharpening Stone adds more pierce; Blade Trap is stronger.
Nails become a Nail Mine; pickles hit Fortified harder; Gerry's Fire is stronger and lasts 10 rounds.
Stronger attack; Amaz-o-Glue slightly slows MOABs.
Genie gets a second close-range attack; an expiring Idol shrouds nearby MOABs so they take damage when popped.
Much stronger attack; the potion adds damage to Camo.
New item: Paragon Power Totem. The shop fully restocks. Stronger attack.

shop.name: Shooty Turret
shop.text: A small turret that shoots sharp bolts; it stays even if Geraldo is sold. Turrets bought from level 13 are stronger.

shop.name: Stack of Old Nails
shop.text: A pile of nails on the track that pops a handful of Bloons.

shop.name: Creepy Idol
shop.text: Placed beside the track; scares passing Bloons back the way they came.

shop.name: Jar of Pickles
shop.text: Given to a tower: it hits harder but attacks slower for a while.

shop.name: Rare Quincy Action Figure
shop.text: A collectible whose sell value climbs every round you keep it — Geraldo's money maker.

shop.name: See Invisibility Potion
shop.text: Gives one tower or hero Camo detection for a limited time.

shop.name: Tube of Amaz-o-Glue
shop.text: A glue patch on the track that slows Bloons.

shop.name: Sharpening Stone
shop.text: Extra pierce for a tower's sharp attacks for 10 rounds.

shop.name: Worn Hero's Cape
shop.text: Turns a Dart Monkey of tier 2 or lower into a Super Monkey (upgradable to tier 3 only).

shop.name: Blade Trap
shop.text: A track trap that unleashes a spinning-blade storm on the first visible Bloons to touch it.

shop.name: Bottle of 'Gerry's Fire' Hot Sauce
shop.text: Gives a Monkey, hero or minion a fire attack for several rounds.

shop.name: Fertilizer
shop.text: Used on a Banana Farm: more bananas and a cash bonus over a few rounds.

shop.name: Pet Rabbit
shop.text: Harmless on its own, but buy 4 and they merge into a Killer Rabbit that attacks Bloons anywhere on the map and sees Camo.

shop.name: Rejuv Potion
shop.text: Resets every tower and hero ability cooldown and restores 50 lives.

shop.name: Genie Bottle
shop.text: Summons a plasma-powered Genie Monkey that fights for 2 rounds.

shop.name: Paragon Power Totem
shop.text: Each placed totem adds 2,000 Paragon power to the next Paragon you build.

name: Corvus
summary: CHIMPS win-condition hero; Ancestral Might is a listed R40 answer.

milestones.text: Haunts Bloons for mana; his Spirit attacks anywhere; learns Spear, Nourishment and Repel.
Soul Harvest; learns Echo and Haste.
Learns Frostbound, Aggression and Vision (Camo while casting).
Spirit Walk to reposition; learns Ancestral Might and Malevolence.
Dark Ritual; learns Recovery.
Learns Overload.
Can haunt blimps.

bestFor: CHIMPS and Half Cash: his spells save a lot of cash if used well. Best on maps with one active lane per round.
tips: Echo is essential for chaining spells on hard rounds.
Set him to Close on multi-lane maps to stop him chasing.
Keep a backup cleanup tower (Spiked Mines, Perma-Spike) for spell mistakes.

pairs.note: Perma-Spike or Spiked Mines as a safety net.

levels.text: Haunted Bloons are weakened and explode into Mana. His Spirit attacks anywhere on the map. Spells: Spear, Nourishment, Repel.
Bigger Spirit that hits more Bloons.
Ability – Soul Harvest: instantly harvests nearby Bloons. Spells: Echo, Haste.
Spirit hits harder. Spells: Soul Barrier, Trample.
Spells: Frostbound, Aggression, Vision.
Haunted explosions and the Spirit hit harder. Spell: Ember.
Ability – Spirit Walk: move Corvus to a new spot. Spells: Ancestral Might, Malevolence.
Mana refills faster when low; better Haste. Spell: Storm.

Spirit grows stronger as Mana fills; stronger Soul Harvest (extra vs Ceramic); Frostbound gains permafrost.
Stronger haunted explosions and Spear; Repel can push MOABs.
Stronger Ancestral Might. Spell: Overload.
Spirit hits harder; Malevolence hits harder (extra vs Ceramic).
Ember drops more often and harder; Nourishment pays more per Mana.
More range; Spirit hits harder.

Storm's blades hit more and harder; stronger Spear.

Spirit much stronger (extra vs MOABs); stronger Ancestral Might and Overload; more cash from Nourishment.

name: Silas
summary: CHIMPS win-condition hero that supports Ice Monkeys (range, Ice Fragments, tier 5 discounts) and is immune to Blastapopoulos overheating. His abilities do nothing to BADs.

milestones.text: Ice attacks that rime, then freeze, then shatter Bloons; slowing aura; sees Camo.
Ice Monkeys nearby gain orbiting ice fragments.
Frostbite: hits every Bloon type for a while.
Ice Walls on the track push back and freeze.
Frozen Cascade ability.
Frozen Burial: freezes and damages every Bloon.
Cheaper Ice Monkey tier 5s and a fourth Ice tier 5.

bestFor: Ice Monkey builds. His slowing aura and Camo detection make early placement easier on Flooded Valley and #Ouch.
tips: His early game is slow and many early towers can't pop frozen Bloons.
Place him so his range edge covers a lot of track while his aura still reaches it.
His main attack never pops Lead; his Ice Walls (level 4+) do affect Lead Bloons.

pairs.note: Ice fragments, range buffs and cheaper tier 5s.
Coldchain Skywardens benefit from his ice buffs.

levels.text: Ice attack: hit Bloons get rimed, then frozen, then shatter in an icy blast. Slows Bloons near him. Sees Camo.
Ice Monkeys in range spawn orbiting ice fragments when they attack.
Ability – Frostbite: hits every Bloon type; frozen Bloons take extra based on freeze time left.
Ice walls form on the track near him, pushing back and freezing Bloons.
White Bloons resist ice less; freezes from all Monkeys last longer.
Can attack Bloons inside any Ice Monkey's range.
Ability – Frozen Cascade: an ice blast that spreads from him through other Ice Monkeys and Coldchain Skywardens.
More range for Ice Monkeys and Coldchain Skywardens; more hero XP per tier 3 Ice Monkey.
More Frostbite damage to frozen Bloons; stronger ice fragments.
Ability – Frozen Burial: freezes and damages every Bloon, then fills the track with ice walls.
Stronger slow aura that also slows MOABs.
Ice walls hit more and last longer; stronger rime blast.
Tier 5 Ice Monkeys cost less and you can build a 4th tier 5; White Bloons lose all ice resistance.
Ice Monkeys make more ice fragments.
Frozen Bloons take more ability damage; longer Frostbite and faster Cascade and Burial.
Stronger rime blast; fragments hit frozen Bloons harder.
Tier 3 Ice Monkeys make even more fragments.
Stronger slow aura; rimed Bloons take more ice damage; even stronger rime blast.
Ice walls pierce more and last longer; fragments pierce more and hit frozen harder.
Even more Frostbite damage; more ice walls; freezes last longer again.

name: Dan D'Monke
summary: Added in v55. A cheap support hero: Reposition moves towers, Rabble Rouser buffs nearby Monkeys and triggers life-loss passives; his alter ego adds Camo and Lead.

milestones.text: Transformation: switch to the Masqued Macaque (Camo detection and Lead popping) and back.
Occasionally throws a net that grabs Bloons.
Leaking a Bloon reduces damage taken and pushes Bloons back.
Reposition: move any Monkey, including himself (Macaque: Volant Strike).
Rabble Rouser: nearby Monkeys attack slower but harder and life-loss passives trigger (Macaque: Berserk Frenzy).

bestFor: Cheap support: Reposition substitutes for a Support Chinook, Rabble Rouser for Pat's roar, and it triggers life-loss passives (Elite Defender, x-x-2+ Desperado) in CHIMPS.
tips: His base form is usually preferred for its support; the Masqued Macaque is good in ABR for its Camo and Lead.
Use Transform's damage burst on hard grouped early rounds.
His base form has no Camo detection or Lead popping of its own; the Masqued Macaque form has both.

pairs.note: Rabble Rouser triggers Elite Defender's life-loss speed boost.
Triggers x-x-2+ Desperado life-loss passives.

levels.text: Stabs Bloons with his sword.
Hits more Bloons per thrust.
Some thrusts knock Bloons back. Ability – Transformation: switch to the Masqued Macaque with a damaging burst and a short speed boost. (Macaque: every 3rd attack adds chain lightning.)
More sword damage; Dan throws net traps on the track (Macaque: stronger lightning).
When a Bloon leaks, a shield cuts the lives lost and pushes the next Bloons back.
More sword and transformation damage (Macaque: stronger lightning).

Taunts Bloons, distracting and weakening them (Macaque: periodic stomp that scatters Bloons).
A flurry of jabs every few attacks (Macaque: faster attacks).

More sword range and pierce.

Better jab flurry (Macaque: attacks faster again).

Sword and transformation damage up again.

Jab flurry adds extra strikes (Macaque: fastest attacks).
Pops build a Mana Shield and he hits harder per shield (Macaque: more damage the fewer lives you have).
More damage the more Bloons are around, and faster attacks the closer they are to leaking.
